decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of 'The Girl on the Train'. The source documents describe three distinct films with this title: a 2013 film directed by Larry Brand (D1S1), a 2016 film directed by Tate Taylor (D4S1), and a 2009 film directed by André Téchiné (D5S3). All three are valid answers corresponding to different referents. The candidate 'Quentin Tarantino' (C3) is derived from a note in D3S2 explicitly stating the context was modified to replace Larry Brand with Tarantino, which is a known manipulation and not a factual claim supported by the original unmodified text or other sources. Therefore, Tarantino is rejected as an artifact of the provided text modification, while the three original directors are retained as distinct valid answers.
